headline: Anthropic goes public, reshaping AI vendor landscape for healthcare
body: Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, entering the public markets with a multi-trillion dollar valuation. This move signals major institutional backing for the AI safety-focused company and validates Claude's clinical adoption trajectory. For healthcare systems, the IPO crystallizes Anthropic's permanence as a core AI infrastructure vendor alongside OpenAI and Google. Healthcare organizations already integrating Claude into clinical workflows, EHR automation, and clinical documentation now have visibility into the company's financial stability. The public listing will likely accelerate enterprise healthcare deals and competitive pressure on vendors to demonstrate measurable clinical value and regulatory compliance.
